Sub: Transcripts of the press conference and earnings call conducted after the Meeting of
Board of directors on October 16, 2025
External Document © 2025 Infosys Limited   1
 Infosys Limited
 Media Conference Call
 CORPORATE PARTICIPANTS:
 Salil Parekh
 Chief Executive Officer and Managing Director
 Jayesh Sanghrajka
 Chief Financial Officer
 Rishi Basu
 Associate Vice President and Global Head - Corporate Communications
 JOURNALISTS
 Ritu Singh
 CNBC TV18
 Rishi Basu
 Good evening, everyone, and welcome to our second quarter results. Over to you, Salil.
 Salil Parekh
 Thanks, Rishi. Based on our performance in the first half and our view of the rest of the year, we
are increasing the lower end of our revenue growth guidance. The new guidance is growth between 2%
and 3% in constant currency terms for the full year. And our operating margin guidance remains the
same as in the past quarter at 20% to 22% for the full year.
 Rishi Basu
 Thank you, Salil. The first question is from Ritu Singh from CNBC TV18.
 Ritu Singh
 Salil, what changed in the second quarter that let you raise the lower end of the guidance?
 Salil Parekh
 We see good traction in large deals and in Financial Services, and that is reflected in the guidance.
